## Nairobi School Trip Weather Checklist, 2026-08-05 to 2026-08-08
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-sun.svg
A cool, mostly dry 4-day stretch for Nairobi, with one day of higher shower risk. Light layers, sun protection, and a small rain backup plan will cover the trip well.

## Day-by-Day Trip Readiness
| Date | Weather | Temp | Rain | Wind | Clothing | Rain Gear | Sunscreen | Zoo Visit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-05 | Cool and clear | 24°C / 13°C | 1 mm | 14 kph | Light jacket, long pants, closed shoes | Optional compact umbrella | Yes, morning and midday | **Good** |
| 2026-08-06 | Possible afternoon showers | 25°C / 14°C | 7 mm | 20 kph | Light layers, waterproof shoes if possible | **Bring raincoat + umbrella** | Yes, especially early | **Fair, better in the morning** |
| 2026-08-07 | Sunny | 23°C / 13°C | 0 mm | 12 kph | Breathable shirt, hat, comfortable walking shoes | Not needed | **Yes** | **Excellent** |
| 2026-08-08 | Partly cloudy | 22°C / 12°C | 3 mm | 15 kph | Light sweater for morning, layered outfit | Small umbrella recommended | Yes | **Good** |

## School Trip Packing Checklist
- **Clothing**
  - Light jacket or sweater for cool mornings and evenings
  - Long pants or comfortable school-appropriate trousers
  - Breathable shirts for daytime
  - Closed, comfortable walking shoes

- **Rain gear**
  - Compact umbrella
  - Lightweight raincoat, especially for 2026-08-06
  - Small plastic bag for wet items

- **Sun protection**
  - Sunscreen
  - Hat or cap
  - Water bottle
  - Sunglasses if allowed

- **Zoo visit note**
  - **Best zoo day:** 2026-08-07
  - **Also suitable:** 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-08
  - **Most cautious day:** 2026-08-06, because afternoon showers and stronger wind may affect outdoor time
